elements.text: following the conversation on trying out clang-format, I had a go. Here's a PR:

The rules in clang-format are a starting point. If you can look at what doesn't work, I can try and make changes to clang-format rules to try and get as close to what we want.

I started with 'Microsoft' styles that ship with clang-format and made some minor changes to conform to some of our existing styles.

Then I thought, it might be best to bring this here to see how much more we want to tweak.

elements.text: The cool thing is, almost all editors support "format code on save" according to clang-format. And there are github actions that allow us to validate format conforms to the clang-format rules as part of the CI pipeline.
